authority.trust: Trusted observer policy, not OS confinement: O_RDONLY prevents descriptor writes but does not restrict read offsets. FOLL_FORCE and inherited fd authority require exact helper and parent admission.

provenance.limits: Retain exact source bytes, debug/DWZ and source-package correspondence before launch. Official kernel tag/source and matching version are not a reproduced-kernel equality claim. Actual toy receipt establishes only its four-byte owned target/fd/EOF/reap behavior.
provenance.profile_digest: boot_profile_inputs.profile_digest(parsed probe profile): SHA256 of json.dumps(profile,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode(UTF8), no trailing newline. Distinct from raw profile_ref.sha256 and from entry-admission profile digest.

sources.binding: mem_open mm_access ATTACH|FSCREDS then mmgrab/file.private_data; read mmget_not_zero; dead mm0; release mmdrop; configured FOLL_FORCE
killable map lock; failed GUP may call vm_ops->access; primitive itself is not restricted to ordinary memory
both ext4 file/DAX vm_ops omit access; this profile nevertheless rejects mixed/PFN/IO maps
source-derived X86CPU allocation uses g_malloc or qemu_memalign, not guest RAM region allocation

abi.generation_binding: exact installed cpu_list_generation_id_get@0x470890 RIP-relative load, not optimized-away DWARF address
abi.queue_rule: QTAILQ union/circular-prev: head.first=CPU;head.prev=CPU+0x238;CPU.node.next=0;CPU.node.prev=head. No conventional tqh_last assumption.

parent_binding.before_spawn: Verify native sigaction handler is SIG_DFL and SA_NOCLDWAIT absent; sole owner/no asynchronous or concurrent reaper. Python getsignal alone is insufficient. Pin reviewed Linux ABI acquisition; unknown flags INCOMPLETE. This packet reads policy and does not install a signal handler. No Popen.poll/wait/other thread may reap QEMU during observation.
parent_binding.before_open: Same policy still holds; Popen-owned unreaped child, one pidfd, no poll/wait/reap until observation ends. Verify private connected QMP SO_PEERCRED pid/uid/gid equals launched child/credentials, fresh soleCPU0 and hostTID, initialprelaunch status. Verify owned proc dir and stat pid/ppid/starttime, exact launched exe descriptor device/inode/hash/BuildID.
parent_binding.proc_rules: Only owned /proc/PID directory; no caller PID. Open fixed members via dirfd; mem O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC and F_GETFL O_ACCMODE==O_RDONLY. The kernel exe magic symlink is the sole explicit file-follow exception. Fresh before/after descriptors; never treat an old maps/exe descriptor as current after exec. pidfd is corroboration, not permission to allow reaping. Separate fixed /proc/self/mountinfo read-only descriptor is allowed only to bind the executable filesystem; no general proc reader.
parent_binding.control_brackets: Fresh QMP status and soleCPU0/TID plus source-audited HMP info registers before/after. Firstslice prelaunch throughout; unexpected state/event INCOMPLETE. Retain identity-only proc equality, complete maps geometry/permissions/backing equality and per-admitted-map VmFlags equality; smaps RSS/accounting bytes need not equal. At reset require derived CPL0,CS64false,LMAfalse and consistency with source-audited HMP reset mode; fields remain exact observations, not executed CPUID.

qmp_allowlist.qom_get: realized and phys-bits only on sole query-cpus-fast returnedCPU0 path
qmp_allowlist.forbidden: all other commands, including cont/stop/reset/migration/hotplug/expansion, and all RSP traffic

mapping_policy.parse: Strict bounded maps/smaps; every row associates uniquely by (start,end,permissions,offset,dev,inode,path). One VmFlags per row, no duplicate tokens; flags on unselected rows are retained without granting read authority. Only admitted rows use the exact whitelist. Check u64 ranges/alignment/nonoverlap; no deleted or ambiguously escaped admitted path. Retain full raw before/after.
mapping_policy.permissions: rw-p only for read spans; require VmFlags rd,wr,mr,mw,me,ac,sd; optional hg,nh only; every other flag unsupported, including io,pf,mm,um,uw,ex,sh. Unknown=>INCOMPLETE; malformed/contradictory=>DENY.

categories.elf_data: same launched executable dev/inode/hash, actual fstype ext4 from bounded mountinfo plus fd statfs0xef53; magic alone does not distinguish ext-family. Match one PT_LOAD and unique PIE bias using page-aligned file offsets. Global complete span within p_memsz and actual admitted VMA.
categories.elf_bss: zero-filled final PT_LOAD file tail or contiguous anonymous continuation with exact segment extent/bias; anonymous dev0/inode0/empty path and approved flags. Do not guess .bss from arbitrary anonymous VMA.
categories.cpu_allocation: head-derived CPU pointer only; full25888-byte X86CPU fits one approved private anonymous map with dev0/inode0/path empty or [heap]; reject guest RAM roles/named anonymous/device/file/stack maps. No map scan to search for a CPU.

mapping_policy.side_effect_boundary: Fixed target/source/control history and these ordinary mapping categories exclude access callbacks; FOLL_FORCE never relaxes observed VM_READ. An unexplained mapping or source-category mismatch prevents field reads. The fd pins mm identity, not pages/layout; equality is observed consistency, not atomicity or arbitrary concurrent remap protection.

phases.gate: head_ready only after exact reads; parent validates full head-derived object map and sends admit_cpu

helper_protocol.processes: One before metadata reader, one field reader, one fresh after metadata reader; at most one active. Parent retains only actual Popen ownership; no QMP/RSP/VARS/device descriptors inherited by helpers. Internal worker fd roles must be distinct and valid; close_fds plus explicit pass_fds. Inherited result pipe is the only output besides capped stderr; no QMP/RSP/guest input descriptors.
helper_protocol.metadata: Private internal --metadata-reader with exactly stat/maps/smaps/exe readonly target fd roles plus readonly parent-namespace mountinfo fd; no PID/path/offset. Fixed output order: u32be length+raw stat, maps, smaps, mountinfo, then u32be length+strict ExeIdentity JSON. Stream-hash bounded exe descriptor against pinned launch bytes with stable initial/final fstat; output identity, not executable copy. Exact EOF after fifth frame. Parent opens fresh /proc/self/mountinfo for the unchanged shared mount namespace and binds the deepest matching mount to exe device/path; fstype must ext4. No supplied arbitrary metadata role. Helper derives the unique fstype among mountinfo rows matching exe st_dev; ambiguity fails. Parent additionally checks the deepest mount covering the fixed launch path from the frozen plan; both must agree, with no path argument accepted by the helper.
helper_protocol.field_input: Two newline-delimited strict JSON frames only, aggregate8192 bytes: Begin then AdmitCPU after head_ready. No trailing frame/byte, external filenames or caller-directed read offset/length. Helper validates nonce/source ABI/compiled constants and read-only mem fd; parent admits maps.
helper_protocol.field_output: Strict newlineJSON<=16384total: read_started before each pread, read_finished after each, one head_ready after phase1, one finished. No fictitious dispatch; pending remains pending on death. Read rows emitted before later syscalls. Duplicate/reordered/extra output invalidates. All channel lengths are charged before allocation; fixed request/result pipes close on error. Worker stderr is a separately capped retained stream.

ReadFinished.hex: exact returned bytes lowercasehex; never padded

helper_protocol.failure: Any zero/short/error pread or protocol failure stops; no retry/completion read. Parent validates every row and derived result independently. Cancellation/first failure is never overwritten by teardown error.
helper_protocol.cancellation: Parent keeps request writer open through normal helper completion and closes it on cancellation. Before every pread and before terminal success, helper checks nonblocking input for cancellation EOF/any extra byte and checks the one aggregate deadline. After it observes EOF/extra byte/failure it dispatches no later pread. A parent close racing after the last check may leave one dispatch in flight; retain actual or pending outcome, never claim retroactive cancellation. No third request frame and no wait for normal input EOF.

limits.witness_deadline: min(now+5s, originalVMdeadline-5s); includes both metadata readers, field handshake,14preads and all helper waits; never reset per phase
limits.kernel_limit: All open/fstat/sigaction/proc/syscall entries checked against remaining deadline; none has a proved hard kernel-return guarantee. Supervision keeps parent responsive to helper stalls; attempted TERM/KILL is not actual reap. Never conceal a pending child.

assertions.name: Strict immutable inputs
assertions.assert: Pin exact profile/argv/ELF/debug+DWZ/ABI/kernel/source/observer files before child creation; missing=>INCOMPLETE, malformed/mismatch=>DENY. Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys, unknowns, NaN, bool integers, overflow and over-budget input before dependent action. Native layout fixture must match sigaction/ucred/statfs exact sizes/alignments/offsets/constants; mismatch has no libc query or dependent read.

assertions.name: True parent and process identity
assertions.assert: Verify SIGCHLD disposition and sigaction flags before Popen and before proc open: not SIG_IGN, no SA_NOCLDWAIT, no handler/thread/other reaper. Wrong parent/PID/starttime/exe/peer credentials or unknown flags causes no mem open. pidfd alone cannot substitute.

assertions.name: Fresh proc descriptors
assertions.assert: Only fixed names stat/maps/smaps/exe/mem through owned proc directory; mem O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC verified F_GETFL. Wrong modes/path/fd roles deny. Real owned fixture confirms write denial with unchanged target and actual waits.

assertions.name: Supervised metadata
assertions.assert: Actual bounded readers retain raw stat/maps/smaps/exe digest from fresh before/after descriptors. Stall/oversize/partial framing/unknown or duplicate VmFlags/extra output stops under shared deadline. No arbitrary path/offset interface. Fresh unrelated metadata fixture succeeds after failure.

assertions.name: Source-backed mapping categories
assertions.assert: Exact maps/smaps row association, ext4 mountinfo+descriptor identity, unique ELF load bias and PT_LOAD file/BSS bounds. Admit only enumerated ordinary mappings; no reads for IO/PFNMAP/mixed/userfaultfd/nonprivate/unreadable/unknown mapping, false ext4 magic-only proof, changed category or boundary overlap.

assertions.name: Two-frame handshake
assertions.assert: One begin then one admit_cpu after exact head progress. Unknown/replayed/out-of-order/oversize frame or caller-selected offset/length denies before dependent pread; head-derived CPU base must match admit_cpu. A fresh independent session succeeds after rejection.

assertions.name: Identity before state
assertions.assert: Bad/null/misaligned/overflowing head or full object outside one admitted map stops after phase1; wrong next/prev/headprev/index/TID stops after phase2. Spy proves no hflags read in either case and no list scan.

assertions.name: Exact read inventory
assertions.assert: Six phases,14 preads,104 bytes only; addresses and sizes independently recomputed from fixed ABI/head. Each read_started precedes syscall; read_finished retains exact return/errno/raw bytes. No retry, merged bulk object read, write or arbitrary address request.

assertions.name: Partial and state failures
assertions.assert: At every pread position, zero/short/errno retains actual bytes, first failure and no later read. Set each NPT/GUEST/SMM bit independently; changed repeated flags/identity/head/generation prevents ADMIT. Decode CPL/CS64/LMA from same retained hflags.

assertions.name: Original mm lifetime
assertions.assert: Real owned exit and exec fixtures show retained fd remains old mm; fresh identity/exe/maps or EOF invalidates it. Never infer current QEMU state from old fd, partial data, pidfd alone or reused PID. Retain actual target/helper waits.

assertions.name: One immutable deadline
assertions.assert: One5s aggregate window covers metadata/handshake/all reads/helper waits, clipped to original VM deadline minus5s reserve. Parent independently supervises stalled/TERM-ignoring helper, preserves first failure/cancellation and bounded TERM/KILL attempts. A requested signal is not a reap; uncertainty remainsINCOMPLETE. Targeted pipe-close race control proves observed cancellation prevents later dispatch, while an already-dispatched read stays actual/pending; normal completion requires no input EOF and remains usable.

assertions.name: Reset-only live scope
assertions.assert: Actual first invocation remains -S/prelaunch, QMP brackets and CPU0/HMP agree, no RESUME/STOP surprise; no RSP connection, guest memory, breakpoint, register writes, calls or profile change. Source/fixture records cannot satisfy live state.

assertions.name: Ownership cleanup and recovery
assertions.assert: Every started helper and QEMU has a separately retained actual wait result; no concurrent helpers and no descriptor/socket/VARS leaks. After cancellation/failure a fresh unrelated owned fixture succeeds. No actual pending child is labeled reaped.

assertions.name: Artifact validation
assertions.assert: Pure validator recomputes all14reads, queue/ABI/map/field links and derived flags from retained raw bytes. Tampered/mislinked/duplicate/missing evidence or missing final bracket cannot PASS. All nine inherited claims plus fresh_c0_verified remainfalse.

assertions.name: Same-stop future dependency
assertions.assert: Reset/synthetic/partial/cleanup-unknown report cannot certify C0. Futurecontext=c0 must match exact run/profile/CPU/TID/stop/ref/resume/breakpoint/control interval and hflags CPL/CS64/LMA with separate actual HMP A20; no cross-stop/reused hint promotion.

assertions.name: Bounded terminal evidence
assertions.assert: All streams/frame/log/report/metadata/VARS bytes charge shared32MiB before growth. Report persistence/cleanup errors retain first failure and bounded terminal report where possible; missing EOF or truncation cannot PASS. No fallback to readv/ptrace/changedprofile/customQEMU.
